title: Two front doors: employees and app users
claim: Employees reach AWS accounts through IAM Identity Center; app users sign in to a Cognito user pool and reach AWS through an identity pool.
alt: Two paths. Top: an employee signs in through an identity provider to IAM Identity Center, which opens a role in each assigned AWS account. Bottom: an app user signs in to a Cognito user pool, the app gets tokens, and an identity pool gives AWS credentials for Amazon S3.

edges.label: sign in
edges.say: An employee signs in once through the identity provider to IAM Identity Center.

edges.label: permission set
edges.say: IAM Identity Center opens a role in each assigned AWS account, created from a permission set.

edges.label: sign in
edges.say: An app user signs in to a Cognito user pool, which issues JSON web tokens (JWTs) to the app.

edges.label: JWT
edges.say: An identity pool exchanges the token for temporary AWS credentials, and the app calls Amazon S3.
